episodes.title: Ankunft
episodes.summary: The inhabitants of the small North Sea island of Sløborn have no inkling of something bad when an American sailing yacht capsizes on its shores. On board a dead couple who apparently committed suicide.

episodes.title: Wirt
episodes.summary: Schoolgirl Evelin realizes that she is pregnant by her teacher Milan. Classmate Herm has made an observation.

episodes.title: Komplizen
episodes.summary: Evelin's father found that the dead on the yacht died of the dangerous pigeon flu. Policeman Mikkel continues to investigate.

episodes.title: Wahrscheinlichkeiten
episodes.summary: The terrible thing has become certain: The pigeon flu has completely caught the island. Two sick students had to be brought to the mainland. Panic breaks out among the residents.

episodes.title: Gegenwehr
episodes.summary: The inhabitants of Sløborn bury their first victim of pigeon flu. Everyone comes together in the cemetery. Evelin feels totally sick himself.

episodes.title: Landunter
episodes.summary: The pigeon flu continues to spread and Sløborn has to be sealed off. The island is to be gradually evacuated. This news is causing concern on the Ostergaard farm.

episodes.title: Widerstand
episodes.summary: The Bundeswehr has now arrived on the island to support the evacuation measures. Antibodies against the virus were found in Evelin's blood.

episodes.title: Zuflucht
episodes.summary: The situation is getting out of control. Evelin's cell phone video from the clinic causes insecurity among the islanders. Resistance Erik rages.

episodes.title: Alles anders
episodes.summary: The island has now been cleared by the German armed forces. Few people are left behind and are struggling to survive.

episodes.title: Gelber Mann
episodes.summary: The power outage on the island poses great challenges for everyone. The supplies in the hotels and shops are still edible, but it's only a matter of time

episodes.title: Da Draußen
episodes.summary: The situation on the deserted island is slowly escalating. The yellow man's secret may have been revealed, but a new challenge awaits those left behind.

episodes.title: Schwelender Brand
episodes.summary: Social worker Freja struggles to keep her group of juvenile delinquents under control. Finally, the dispute with Devid escalates.

episodes.title: Keine Träume
episodes.summary: Evelin and her small community of convenience want to leave the island as soon as possible. They plan to hijack the ship of the pirates who come to plunder once a week.

episodes.title: Weg hier
episodes.summary: Evelin and her group flee to the mainland on a makeshift raft, chased by Erik and his pirates.

episodes.title: Eine Neue Welt
episodes.summary: Evelin and her friends have found a new home in the Husum hospital. After several months of the pandemic, supplies are running out and energy supplies are becoming increasingly critical.

episodes.title: Mach Dich Nützlich
episodes.summary: Evelin goes on an illegal search for her father and comes across an unscrupulous doctor in the looters' camp who is looking for a cure for pigeon flu in her blood.

episodes.title: Die Große Chance
episodes.summary: While Evelin tries to break out of the prison cell, Lobo, Solveig and Hatice prepare to escape from the camp. Paul Fried plays a special role.

episodes.title: Die Leise Nacht
episodes.summary: Evelin and her friends manage to escape from the looters' camp, but the price is high. When camp boss Erik returns home, he vows revenge for his daughter's death.

episodes.title: Klabaster Sterben Einsam
episodes.summary: Evelin and her friends narrowly escaped the camp. But the bloody outbreak claimed numerous lives. The camp chief's daughter also died.

episodes.title: Sünden Der Väter
episodes.summary: Evelin and her friends make the dangerous journey to Berlin by water because the roads have become too dangerous. Erik is still hot on the teenagers' heels.
